observed_pattern.window_definition: neutral land selected while frontierConversionTiming recommended conversion, an executor-ready rival action existed at >=1.30 relative troop ratio, and own tile share was 5-15 percent

diagnosis.critique: The observational association was strong, but it did not establish that an immediate ratio-only probe caused later wins. It omitted target exposure, counterattack topology, economy timing, and seat effects.

candidate_change.description: At 5-12 percent tile share, select a 10 percent rival attack before neutral land when the best available rival ratio is at least 1.30.
candidate_change.scope: one selector ordering branch and one regression test

verdict.reason: The parent won the matched replay despite direct candidate reach and accepted cv2 actions.
verdict.source_action: candidate selector and test removed; exact v77 parent restored
verdict.next_hypothesis: Use a policy population and empirical payoff matrix. Add target-quality and retaliation-risk features before testing another conversion rule.
